question: Which of the following was the mascot of the 37th National Games?
solution: The correct answer is __**Moga**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The mascot of the **37th National Games** held in **Goa** was **Moga**. • **Moga** represents the **Indian Bison**, which is known for its strength, endurance, and adaptability, aligning with the spirit of sportsmanship. • The name **Moga** is derived from the Konkani word "**Mog**", which means "**love**", symbolizing the warmth and hospitality of the state of Goa. • The **37th National Games** took place in **2023** after a significant gap due to various challenges such as the COVID-19 pandemic. • **Moga** was introduced to promote the games and enhance the enthusiasm of athletes and spectators, reflecting the culture and biodiversity of Goa.
